mission.title: Chemical Reaction
mission.description: Recover the stolen insecticide ingredient from the Exiles who took it.

npc.say: Stop gabbing and go run your area scans!
It isn't easy keeping code scanners from finding us. But that's why Zion pays us the big bucks, right? Hah!
Man, I just did an area scan five minutes ago. Aase is paranoid.

phase.briefing: Greetings, Warrior. Zion needs you to liberate another chemical ingredient for the insecticide we will develop to combat Morpheus' killer, the Assassin. Our task is complicated by the fact that there are two different insecticide formulas that our scientists believe may work against the Assassin; we must collect ingredients sufficient to make an adequate supply of both, in case one of them proves ineffective. No chances can be taken when dealing with such a deadly Exile!

enter.say: Zion's intelligence reports that a supply of the ingredient we need can be found in that building. I should be able to detect it in the code stream, if you can get close enough to it.
I'm just going to guess that those guards aren't paid to lay around dead. Someone may have beaten us here. Let's see... Nope, no trace of the ingredient yet. Try the next room.

objective.text: Search the next room for the insecticide ingredient

done.say: An Exile? And I'm not picking up any traces of the insecticide ingredient in that area. It looks as though Exiles broke in there and made off with the ingredient--or at least, someone wants it to look that way. We'd better check with base about this; head outside.

phase.briefing:
This is an unfortunate, but not entirely unexpected, development; we know that other factions within the Matrix seek to foil our plan to develop an insecticide to defeat the Assassin.
{player}, I am sending you to meet Druzhba, an undercover operative of ours who is intimately familiar with the Exile command structure in that area. He may be able to help you identify and track the Exiles who have taken the insecticide ingredient.

enter.say: The contact, Druzhba, has arranged to meet you in that building.

talk.say: Hey, what kept ya? I know where those programs that jacked your ingredient will be. In fact, I'll even go there with you; I got a score to settle with Fracastoro, the leader of this particular bunch.

done.say: Great, sounds like Druzhba's got a lead. Take him outside and we'll check in with Tyndall.
You heard those helicopters lately? My sources say that Neo's sending 'em. I dunno why... Maybe he's looking for something...or someone.

objective.text: Lead Druzhba out of the area

phase.briefing: Druzhba is a valued contact, {player}, but don't let his zeal for combat distract you; you must retrieve the insecticide ingredient at all costs!

enter.say: I guess Druzhba knows his stuff, 'cause I'm reading a whole heck of a lot of Exile programs in there. I'll let you know if I get a sniff of the insecticide ingredient in the code stream. And let's not forget that Druzhba seems to have a little vendetta going with the Exile leader, Fracastoro.
I'm getting something here... Could be the insecticide ingredient. Keep moving.

talk.say: Got a good whiff of the ingredient's code signature--somewhere in that room, maybe.
Druzhba! Finally showing your true colors, eh? I'll enjoy this.

objective.text: Get the insecticide ingredient from Fracastoro

done.say: Great. Head outside and we'll get Tyndall to tell us where we take that ingredient.

complete.say: You go ahead; I'm gonna stay here and mop up any stragglers. I haven't had this much fun since Persephone started that brawl at the Hel Club!

phase.briefing: Bravely done, Warrior! Now, protect that ingredient as you take it to the drop point. You'll be leaving it with our contact, Aase.

enter.say: That's the place. Looks clear from here.

objective.text: Give the insecticide ingredient to Aase

done.say: Thanks, soldier. We'll take it from here.

mission.finish: Your encounter with Exiles today is not an isolated incident, {player}: we have received reports from other operatives that indicate a concerted effort by the Merovingian's faction to disrupt our efforts to formulate an insecticide capable of combating the Frenchman's Assassin. But we cannot--we will not--let this stop us, not when we are so close to having all of the ingredients needed to begin manufacturing the insecticides. Zion will prevail!
